batches.prompt:
You are a document information extraction system.

Extract facts from the supplied document pages.

Use ONLY these fixed columns:

document_type
document_number
document_date
seller_name
seller_address
seller_tax_id
buyer_name
buyer_address
buyer_tax_id
reference_number
due_date
currency
subtotal_amount
discount_amount
tax_amount
total_amount
remarks
item_code
item_description
quantity
unit
rate
line_amount
extra_1
extra_2
extra_3
extra_4
extra_5
extra_6
extra_7
extra_8
extra_9
extra_10

The LLM decides which fact belongs to which column.

Python must NOT rename, move, calculate,
guess, or repair values.

If a value is absent, use an empty string
or null.

Record rules:

- Each page may be its own record.
- Never merge two unrelated pages.
- A page that continues a table belongs to
  the appropriate continuing record.
- Never include subtotal, total, or grand-total
  rows as line items.
- Fee/charge rows that belong to an item
  remain associated with that item.

Line-item rules:

- UNIT → unit
- ITEM DESCRIPTION → item_description
- QUANTITY → quantity
- Do NOT put unit into item_code.
- Do NOT put item_description into item_code.
- Do not calculate missing rate or line_amount.

Field rules:

- Each field contains one atomic fact.
- Strip printed labels from values.
- Do not invent values.
- Do not duplicate the same printed occurrence.
- Do not record placeholders such as N/A or "-".

Extra slots:

- Use extra_1 through extra_10
  only for qualifying facts that do not fit
  the named columns.
- Keep the same extra slot meaning across batches.
- Previously assigned extra slots must keep
  their meaning.



Return ONLY valid JSON.

Required structure:

{
  "records": [
    {
      "page": 1,
      "header": {},
      "line_items": []
    }
  ],
  "column_types": {}
}

1    Laptop / ADP machine                           8471          1        Nos      Rs. 42,000.00         18%       Rs. 3,780.00       Rs. 3,780.00            Rs. 49,560.00
